boxes.text: Left outlet sends off/on messages to control module inlets
Center outlet sends 0/1 to turn Vizzie module on and off

boxes.comment: Reset the module to the full data range.

boxes.text: You can use a RANGR module to produce 2-step sequences
Right outlet sends 1.0 for on, 0. for off
An integer 1 or 0 in the left inlet enables or disables the module.

boxes.comment: Restart the generation of values at mid-range.
